name: @slotwise/asc-pdf-import
description: Turns aSc timetable PDFs (one class per page) into a Slotwise dataset file

scripts.chitkara: node parse.mjs Class_Wise_Time_Table.pdf -o parsed-cse-ai.json --pages 1-22,24-33 && node parse.mjs Group_Wise_Time_Table.pdf -o parsed-cse.json --pages 1-18 && node build-dataset.mjs ../../server/data/chitkara-cse-ai.json parsed-cse-ai.json parsed-cse.json
